title: Hukmaran Mola Hussain As
body:
Zindagi me jiski mehwar karbala
Sayebañ hai uske sar par karbala
2 thikane matami ke hain faqat
Arsh per jannat zameeñ pe karbala
Saltanat haq ki per Karbala hai
Aur uska hukmaran moula hussain as
Aj bhi khaliq ke lab per ye sada hai
Deen ka hai sayebañ moula hussain
1* Apne roze pe bulayega hussain as
Paak naslon ko banayega hussain as
Karbala jane ki niyat tou karo
Misle fitroos par lagayega hussain as
Bas usi par is karam ki inteha hai
Jispe hoga meherban moula hussain
2* hur , habeeb o jaun banjayenge hum
Wahab sa kirdar apnayenge hum
Karbala par anch na aaye koi
Azm dil me rakh ke ye aayenge hum
Har Hussaini misle meesam ashna hai
Waar dega apni jaañ moula hussain as
4* Qabr me karwant bhi na badli gayi
Thi kamar kham , pusht bhi tuti huwi
Keh rahen ye zamane ke imam
yaad karke shah e deen ki bekasi
pusht ko kitna jhuka kar chaldiya hain
Apka beta jawan moula hussain
5* Ek ajab halaat hai maqtal gaah ki
Rooz aati hai sada ek aah ki
Aur kehti hai zameen e karbala
Dekhti hai pasliyan jab shah ki
Farq e ghurbat lamha lamha mit Raha hai
Maa pisar ke darmiyan moula hussain as
6* pyaas , garmi, teer o talwar o imam as
Hai sar o saman khoon aluda shaam
Zaqm e shamsheer o sina unnisou
Ranjisheñ aayin joh nazron me tamam Har mauariq ne yehi rokar likha hai
Saqt tha ye imtehan Moula hussain as
7*hogayi pur noor sehra ki zameen
Karb se khaali hai ab ye bil yaqeen
Aye rajjul dekho zara to
u sheher ko
Is ko karne ke liye itna haseen
Deen ke haq me lahu itna diya hai
Aj tak hai natawan moula hussain
